dct_description_sm: California as an island with a flat top following the Briggs model. Place names include C. Mindocino, C. S. Martin, and C. del Enganno. At 58 degrees N is Anian and the unnamed strait.

Issued in: Philippi Cluverii introdvctionis in vniversam geographiam tam veterem quam novam libri VI. Tabulis æneis illustrari. Accessit P. Bertii breviarium orbis terrarum. / Amstelodami : Ex Officina Elzeviriana, 1659. Reissued in 1661, 1670, 1672, 1677, and possibly in other editions.Issued
Issued in: Philosophica Naturalis / Henricus Regius, 1661.
Title in block type betwee the two hemispheres.
